### Hope for the Nations
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/hope-nations
Passage: Jeremiah 12:16-17
Points:
- Jeremiah struggled with why the wicked prospered while he faced persecution and death plots.
- God answered that even greater hardships lay ahead before Judah would be disciplined and exiled.
- The pagan neighbors who devastated Judah would also face divine uprooting for their sins.
- The Lord extended hope of restoration and inclusion to any nation that turns to Him.
- Believers must walk by faith, trusting God's sovereign goodness even when life seems confusing.
